Infrared spectroscopy confirms that Al2O3 films on GaAsO/GaAs are amorphous, as for ALD-grown Al2O3 on Si. This is evidenced by absorption features at 720 and 955 cm−1 (Fig. 3) which may be assigned to transverse-optical (TO) and longitudinal-optical (LO) phonon modes of amorphous Al2O3, respectively.
